args.value: OPEN: how Faros itself is priced is the cleanest FinOps-vs-platform tell. Ali's intended call: platform/outcome pricing (seats / connected-org tier), NOT consumption or savings-based, because consumption pricing structurally bends the product toward 'spend less' and collapses the positioning. Public anchor seen: ~$29/contributor/month, ~4:1 ROI. Confirm on live fetch.
